sequence: durable intention -> stock succeeded (including authorized difference) -> cash succeeded -> completed; no number before completion. Unknown/404 is not rejection.
snapshot: Immutable commercial capture at acceptance, distinct completed_at; D01-D13. F1 runtime pending_profile only. Resolved synthetic supported forms do not activate fiscal calculation or emission.
identity: Current human authority before lookup/replay/capture/acceptance; semantic uniqueness tenant+operation+sale+payment survives HTTP replay seven days; exact accepted response/Location preserved. Resume preserves intention/steps/commands, expected_version, reason and recent step-up; no editing/cancel/free payment status.
history: ADR-063 section 4: retained original UTF-8 JSON and checksum, per-org sequence serialized until commit, sessions <=30min and current human authority/step-up each page. Cursor HMAC exclusive key binds account/tenant/session/filters/limit/H/last/version/disposition generation; 50 default/100 max, page <=1MiB, fact <=128KiB. Changed generation returns 409; gaps mean partial, unknown source 503; reading never republishes or executes.
retries: Same immutable command; maximum five logical attempts with exponential backoff 1s+jitter capped 30s, Retry-After, attention after exhausted or 15min. Transport redelivery never resets budget; no auto refund or stock compensation on unknown/success.
compatibility: completed.v2 / revision 1 / tax snapshot 1 / sales-f1-ars-1. Strict producer, reader only optional extensions.source_note; unknown critical enums/type/revision/snapshot/policy quarantine without effect or checkpoint.
obligations_runtime: F1-13 PostgreSQL/RLS/atomic intention and process transitions/unique numbering/inbox/outbox/history/current authority/crypto/broker/reordering/lost response/restart at each transition; F1-15 browser and decimal parity. Fixtures do not prove runtime.

synthetic_fiscal_vectors.included_base: For this synthetic parallel-percentage policy: raw base = commercial line gross / (1 + sum supported included taxable rates / 100), represented HALF_UP at 34 fractional digits. No tax is recalculated from a base closed to cents.
synthetic_fiscal_vectors.theoretical_amount: raw captured base * captured rate / 100, represented HALF_UP at 34 fractional digits; zero for explicit exempt/not_taxable.
synthetic_fiscal_vectors.group_tax: Sum raw component calculations within jurisdiction/tax/treatment/concept/category/rate/rule/currency group, then HALF_UP once to 2 decimals.
synthetic_fiscal_vectors.tax_allocation: Floor each exact theoretical component at 2 decimals, distribute group closing cents by descending exact fractional remainder; stable line_id breaks ties. No display/arrival-order tie-break.
synthetic_fiscal_vectors.allocated_base: For each line, commercial gross minus all assigned included tax amounts; all components in this supported parallel-base policy retain that net. Nonnegative required. Totals sum the primary VAT treatment allocated bases once, never double-count another jurisdiction.
synthetic_fiscal_vectors.residues: allocated_residue = assigned tax amount - represented theoretical_amount; base_residue = allocated_base - represented raw base. Signed decimal strings up to 34 fraction digits, negative zero forbidden. Groups preserve sums of raw/allocated bases and their explicit residue.
synthetic_fiscal_vectors.rules: Only SYNTHETIC_VAT@1 and SYNTHETIC_OTHER@1 are supported in this oracle. Validate component/group/recipient/decision references; real profiles/rules require their own accepted cut.
synthetic_fiscal_vectors.evidence: Connected snapshots include 0.01–0.05, two 0.03 lines, three equal cent lines with allocation tie, and multiple jurisdictions. Fiscal vectors do not authorize production emission.
